extra.evidence: A small transformer that writes and sketches from text. The effort was 80% data, 15% speed and 5% architecture: my first project that follows the Bitter Lesson. So apologies for this move - all of my other posts were written by me, and all future posts will be as well. Even if you find Claude more comprehensible than my meandering thoughts, meander nonetheless I shall. Last year Zach Wimpee and I trained a tiny GPT to write cursive . items.title: Claude 和 ChatGPT 在蛋白质结构预测和设计上挑战 AlphaFold
items.summary: AI 生物科技公司 Phylo 研究员 Xinming Tu 本月初使用 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Google 的大模型测试了它们预测鲜为人知细菌蛋白质序列的能力。他让分析程序运行了整晚，第二天对结果非常吃惊。Anthropic 最新版本的Claude 表现不仅优于其它大模型，而且超过了针对蛋白质序列训练过的专门工具。他与哈佛医学院的 Leo Chen 分享的这一发现在计算生物学界引发了热议。本周二 OpenAI 宣布其最新大模型成功设计出新蛋白质，在实验室合成和测试时部分新蛋白质的行为和预期一样。该研究引发了 生物 AI 未来的讨论，部分科学家预测 Claude 和 ChatGPT 之类的通用模型在蛋白质结构预测和设计等任务上可能会超越 AlphaFold 等专用工具。也有研究人员对此提出质疑，认为大模型展现出的部分能力可能只是训练数据的机械重复。

items.title: Migrating our Messages API to Rust

extra.evidence: How we used the existing Messages API to verify the new one, with teams of Claude agents tracking down and fixing differences between the Python and Rust versions. Many problems have a generator–verifier gap: it’s often far easier to verify that a solution is correct than to come up with one. Sudoku is a classic example. It’s simple to check the solution (just count the numbers in each row, column, and box), but finding that solution can take a long time. Many ambitious Claude projects have relied on this gap: formalizing proofs in mathematics or migrating large, well-tested codebases are tasks Claude can take on as long as it has a reliable way to verify its work. But as Claude has become more capable, it’s begun to take on projects in live systems, where generating the work is easier th…

items.title: Lazy Agents Answer Against Their Own Beliefs: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs Teaches Them to Act on What They Believe
items.summary: AI agents working on long tasks often commit to an answer before they have enough evidence, a behavior called laziness. In our evaluations, they frequently commit even while their stated belief still names several possible answers. An outcome reward at the end of the episode scores only the final answer, so it cannot teach the agent when to commit, because a lucky guess receives the same reward as an answer backed by evidence. During training, however, the simulator can compute the exact posterior over the answer at every step and tell whether the evidence is already enough. We propose Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Beliefs (RLVB), which rewards the agent for taking further steps while this posterior still allows several answers and for committing once the evidence is sufficient. The reward needs no judge, critic or reward model, and it never reads the belief line the agent writes before each action. We also introduce Pro Worlds, a benchmark of visual puzzles where the agent views a large world through a small window. We evaluate three vision-language models on three benchmarks, two of which are never seen in training. RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average. Under the outcome reward, GRPO and PPO fall below the base model on average. RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours. The trained agent answers with sufficient evidence in 51%, 12% and 74% of the epi…

items.title: Don't Sleep, Keep Watch: Proactive Perception for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents (CUAs) built on vision-language models are increasingly entrusted with long-horizon tasks in live desktop, web, and mobile environments, where the screen keeps changing on its own. However, current CUAs lack real-time situational awareness: they perceive the environment through discrete snapshots, and the substantial inference latency of VLMs, compounded by highly dynamic interfaces, opens a perception-action gap in which the observed state frequently becomes stale before the corresponding action is executed. To bridge this gap, we present NightWatch, a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space. NightWatch couples the VLM agent with NightWatch-0.8B, a lightweight System-1 model that performs streaming monitoring of the interface state and keeps the agent synchronized with the evolving environment at low computational cost and latency, thereby grounding each decision in the current state rather than an outdated snapshot and reducing both stale actions and idle waiting while preserving task success. Experiments on desktop and dynamic web environments (OSWorld-Verified and DynaCU-Bench) show that NightWatch, driven by a watcher of only 0.8B parameters, reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2% with the large VLM agent, and is mor…

items.title: Rewirable Circuits in Transformers with Loom Attention
items.summary: We propose loom attention, which allows a Transformer to dynamically rewire its circuits at every token by interweaving a head's vertical attention over the outputs of earlier heads (to obtain its query, key and value) with its horizontal attention over tokens. We instantiate vertical attention efficiently with normalized and gated linear attention over a per-token matrix memory, which stores the compressed head outputs and serves as a second residual stream. This yields LoomFormer, a dual-stream architecture that splits control and content between the vector and matrix streams. Across model sizes and training token budgets in language modeling and downstream tasks, LoomFormer matches Transformers trained with over 3x compute and recent residual-stream baselines (HC/mHC, MUDDFormer, AttnRes) trained with ~1.7-2.8x. For example, trained on the same 300B tokens with only 2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B achieves ~1.6x the average downstream gain of mHC-Pythia-2.8B over Pythia-2.8B, and matches (0-shot) or surpasses (5-shot) Pythia-12B. Code is available at https://github.com/Caiyun-AI/LoomFormer
items.summary_zh: 论文提出了Loom Attention机制，允许Transformer在每一步动态重连电路。实验表明，LoomFormer在语言建模和下游任务中，仅需较少计算量即可达到或超越更大模型的性能。

items.title: MH-RAG-DIVE: Dynamic and Cost-Efficient Multi-Hop RAG Evaluation via Tree-Cached Dialogue Simulation
items.summary: Quality assessment is essential for determining whether changes to a Retrieval-Augmented Generation system improve or maintain its performance. However, existing evaluation approaches often rely on single-turn or single-hop interactions and therefore do not capture the complexity of multi-hop, multi-turn conversations. We introduce MH-RAG-DIVE, a dynamic interactive user simulation framework designed to evaluate RAG systems in more complex multi-hop and multi-turn settings. The framework extends RAG-DIVE with a Context Discoverer, which identifies documents that can be combined to generate multi-hop questions within an ongoing conversation. To address the high computational cost of dynamic user simulation, we further introduce a Conversation Cacher, which reuses turns from previous evaluation runs while preserving the dynamic nature of the evaluation. We evaluate the framework across six distinct RAG configurations and compare its results with the original RAG-DIVE evaluation and the static, human-created CLAPNQ dataset. Our experiments show consistent performance trends across the evaluation approaches, while the more complex multi-hop and multi-turn setting exposes additional challenges for RAG systems. Furthermore, the Conversation Cacher substantially reduces token consumption, demonstrating its potential to make dynamic evaluation more cost-efficient. Finally, we apply MH-RAG-DIVE to an industrial RAG system with domain-specific data, demonstrating its applicability to…

items.title: Fast 4-bit KV-Cache Decoding on Hopper GPUs: Why Existing Kernels Are Slow and How to Fix Them
items.summary: A 4-bit KV cache reads about half the bytes of FP8, but Hopper GPUs have no FP4 hardware and little instruction-issue capacity per byte of memory bandwidth, so 4-bit values must be decoded in software. On H200, vLLM's NVFP4 KV path (FlashInfer's decode) reaches 10-20% of memory bandwidth and is up to 1.7x slower than FP8. NVBit instruction counts show two causes: the kernels behind vLLM's 4-bit paths (FlashInfer NVFP4, Triton UltraQuant) execute 2-6x Hopper's issue budget per byte and serialize loading, decoding and matrix multiplies. Our Hopper-native decode kernel overlaps a TMA producer warp with two compute warpgroups, lays the cache out at write time so decoded values feed the tensor cores from registers, and swaps the matrix operands so small query groups need no padding. On H200 it reaches 67-75% of peak bandwidth at batch 32-128 and at all 11 shapes is 1.12-1.49x faster than the faster of XQA and FlashAttention-4's proposed native FP8. Inside vLLM, with an accuracy recipe (K mean removal and rotation, 4 BF16 sink tokens, BF16 layer 0), it decodes 1.12-1.64x faster per step on Llama-3.1-8B than vLLM's FlashInfer FP8 path at batch 8 and above (1.04-1.24x over FlashAttention-4's FP8), is level at batch 1, and holds 1.63x as many tokens. On one H200 under a reasoning-like request stream, the highest rate at which 99% of requests meet the latency targets is 1.23-1.32x FP8's on Llama-3.1-8B and 1.67-2.20x on Qwen2.5-72B, as the cache becomes the limit; prefill-heavy stream…

b47f1938aec6.body: 前沿AI已经能解决以前顶级物理学家需要一整天才能解决的问题。

0e003a90c1b3.headline: Claude和ChatGPT挑战AlphaFold
0e003a90c1b3.body: Anthropic最新版Claude在鲜为人知细菌蛋白质序列预测上表现优于其它大模型，OpenAI宣布其大模型成功设计出新蛋白质。

3d7a5c0812e7.headline: Anthropic将Messages API迁移至Rust
3d7a5c0812e7.body: Anthropic使用Claude智能体验证新API，利用生成器-验证器差距修复Python和Rust版本的差异。

f113b3a5d2f6.headline: OpenAI展示AI降低软件生产成本
f113b3a5d2f6.body: OpenAI工程师展示AI如何让软件生产成本降低，同时保留手工打磨的精细感。

9be62e7232c9.headline: Hy4 flash模型开源
9be62e7232c9.body: 腾讯混元开源Hy4 flash的GGUF量化权重，官方实测在48GB显存设备上生成速度最高到每秒89个token。

273642eaf7ff.headline: LibreOffice收紧AI辅助代码贡献政策
273642eaf7ff.body: 文档基金会发布更严格规则，要求贡献者披露AI工具使用情况并解释代码修改原理。

1589247f1bbf.headline: Mastra：现代 TypeScript AI 应用框架
1589247f1bbf.body: Mastra 是一个现代的 TypeScript 框架，用于构建 AI 驱动的应用程序和智能体。

eb513fb038f2.headline: EdgeEver：AI 原生笔记应用
eb513fb038f2.body: EdgeEver 是一个 AI 原生笔记应用，支持 Evernote/Obsidian 替代品，提供即时多平台同步和 MCP 支持。

a85c150d0ff2.headline: KuroCat：3D桌面打字小黑猫与AI编程伴侣
a85c150d0ff2.body: KuroCat是一个开源的3D/2D桌面打字小黑猫与AI编程伴侣，支持多种AI模型和平台。

e7a4b8e7ef7b.headline: GenAI_Agents：50+生成式AI智能体教程
e7a4b8e7ef7b.body: GenAI_Agents仓库包含50多个生成式AI智能体教程和实现，涵盖从基础对话机器人到复杂多智能体系统。

36442496d986.headline: Audiocraft：深度学习音频处理库
36442496d986.body: Audiocraft是一个深度学习音频处理和生成库，包含EnCodec音频压缩器和MusicGen音乐生成模型。

4aeaa2ec3e5e.headline: agent-sim：AI智能体iOS模拟器
4aeaa2ec3e5e.body: agent-sim是一个在Linux上运行的AI智能体iOS模拟器，为x86Sim提供智能体层。

acda2684c9cc.headline: Lazy Agents：利用可验证信念强化学习
acda2684c9cc.body: 论文提出了可验证信念强化学习方法，利用模拟器计算后验概率指导智能体行动，提升长任务性能。

d25c0b99747f.headline: NightWatch：计算机使用代理主动感知框架
d25c0b99747f.body: 论文提出了NightWatch框架，通过轻量级系统模型实时监控界面状态，减少感知滞后并提高任务成功率。

9c0fa0d320de.headline: LoomFormer提出可重连电路Transformer
9c0fa0d320de.body: LoomFormer引入Loom Attention机制，允许Transformer动态重连电路，在语言建模和下游任务中仅需较少计算量即可达到或超越更大模型的性能。

231e8cc0a447.headline: MH-RAG-DIVE框架提升多跳RAG评估效率
231e8cc0a447.body: MH-RAG-DIVE框架通过动态用户模拟和对话缓存技术，提高了多跳多轮对话中RAG系统的评估效率，展示了在工业级系统中的应用潜力。

6eb54435e7d8.headline: Hopper GPU上4-bit KV-Cache解码优化
6eb54435e7d8.body: 论文提出原生解码内核解决Hopper GPU上4-bit KV-Cache解码的性能瓶颈，在Llama-3.1-8B和Qwen2.5-72B上显著提升了解码速度。
